## What Was Requested

Read the task brief: /Users/sumandra/projects/talium/code-econ/.superpowers/sdd/task-4-brief.md

Global constraints from the spec that bind this task:
- A segment ({12-digit counter}.jsonl) is the ship/ACK/delete unit; deleted only on ACK (at-least-once). Open partial file rotates at batch_max_events / batch_max_bytes; seal() closes on demand; a crash-left open partial is sealed on next construction so nothing is lost.
- FIFO by filename; counter recovered from highest existing name across restarts.
- SpoolFullError raised above max_bytes (caller decides block-or-drop).
- Structured logging via structlog with module field; event content never appears in logs.
- Commit messages never mention Claude/AI, no Co-Authored-By lines.
